verdict.rationale: Bevy is a game engine and app framework, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it. A runtime probe states that no official MCP exists. The only MCP tooling found is a community project (natepiano/bevy_brp) built on the first-party Bevy Remote Protocol, which is a developer building block plus third-party tooling and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
